claims.claim_ar: فعل يَتَضَرَّعُونَ يدلُّ على معنى التضرع والذلّ والخشوع في الدعاء، كما بيّن النصّ: «تَضَرُّعاً وَخُفْيَةً نصب على الحال».
claims.claim_en: The verb yattaḍarraʿūn indicates humble supplication, meekness, and inner humility in prayer — as indicated by the phrase: "تَضَرُّعاً وَخُفْيَةً نصب على الحال".
claims.rhetorical_effect: Highlights the intended response (humble, inward supplication) that God’s punishments are meant to elicit from the people; creates emotional appeal to remorse and humility.
